businesses.business: Commercial aircraft engine leasing and aftermarket services

offering_description.value: Leases commercial jet engines and aircraft to airlines and other aviation operators. It also sells replacement engine modules and used serviceable parts and provides engine repairs and module exchanges to airlines, lessors and maintenance providers.

primary_products.value: Replacement engine modules; used serviceable engine parts; commercial jet engines

primary_services.value: Jet engine leasing; engine maintenance and repair; engine module exchanges; commercial aircraft leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Passenger and cargo airlines, aircraft and engine lessors, and aviation maintenance providers

end_markets.value: Passenger aviation; air cargo; aircraft and engine leasing; aviation maintenance and repair

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Commercial jet engines and aircraft leased to operators; product sales: Replacement modules, used serviceable parts and complete engines; service fees: Engine maintenance, repair and module exchanges
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Acquires commercial engines and aircraft and leases them to aviation operators; service provider: Repairs engines and exchanges modules for airlines, lessors and maintenance providers; distributor: Sources serviceable engine components and supplies them to airlines and maintenance providers

geography_served.value: global: Serves aviation customers across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Commercial engine and aircraft leasing, engine module exchanges, repairs and replacement parts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct lease agreements, parts sales and service contracts with aviation customers; own locations: Company-operated engine maintenance facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Engine maintenance facilities need aviation authority approvals and must follow FAA and EASA airworthiness and return-to-service rules.
